title: Shadowing and Lipschitz Shadowing in Symbolic Dynamics: Finite vs. Infinite Alphabets
summary: We point out a basic dichotomy between the shadowing and Lipschitz shadowing properties for one-sided shift spaces in two infinite-alphabet frameworks: the classical product-topology model $X\subseteq A^{\mathbb{N}}$ and the compact Ott--Tomforde--Willis (OTW) model obtained by adjoining finite words. In the product-topology setting, for the natural class of prefix ultrametrics, shadowing and Lipschitz shadowing coincide.
